newsitem.title: USA: Amquest says retires 15.15 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Amquest says retires 15.15 mln common shrs.

text.p: Amquest International Ltd said Wednesday it has retired 13.15 million regulation S shares and two million rule 144 regulation D shares into its treasury.
The company said the retired shares could have potentially impacted its trading beginning in July.
The company said it executed the buyback agreements with a group of shareholders that exchanged Brazilian judicial bonds for its restricted securities in 1996.
These shareholders, as the result of the company's stock price decline, agreed to retire their common shares plus a total of 10 million series "A" convertible redeemable preferred shares.
The company said they took this step in exchange for shares being issued into a closed-end mutual fund to be formed and managed by an Amquest subsidiary.
The company said this move reduces its outstanding common shares by about 40 percent, leaving 22,265,000 common shares issued and outstanding.
The company said it expects to retire more common shares into its treasury through other initiatives. The company said
this reflects its belief that its stock is undervalued.
